191 |     def load_fixed_weir_file(self, filepath):
192 |         """Parse fixed-weir text file and create both polyline and point layers"""
193 |         base_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(filepath))[0]
194 | 
195 |         # --- Polyline layer ---
196 |         poly_layer = QgsVectorLayer(f"LineString?crs=EPSG:28992", base_name + "_lines", "memory")

203 |         point_pr = point_layer.dataProvider()
204 |         point_fields = [
205 |             QgsField("weir_name", QVariant.String),
206 |             QgsField("crest_lvl", QVariant.Double),

212 |             QgsField("rough_cd", QVariant.Double)
213 |         ]
214 |         point_pr.addAttributes(point_fields)
215 |         point_layer.updateFields()
216 | 
217 |         # --- Read file ---
218 |         with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
219 |             lines = [line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()]
220 | 
221 |         i = 0
222 |         while i < len(lines):
223 |             if ":" in lines[i]:  # new weir block

227 |                 i += 1

233 |                     x, y = map(float, parts[:2])

241 |                     point_pr.addFeature(point_feat)
242 |

247 |                 poly_feat.setGeometry(QgsGeometry.fromPolylineXY(pts))
248 |                 poly_feat.setAttributes([weir_name])
249 |                 poly_pr.addFeature(poly_feat)
250 |             else:
251 |                 i += 1
252 | 
253 |         # Add layers to project

66 |     def processAlgorithm(self, parameters, context, feedback):
67 |         source = self.parameterAsSource(parameters, self.TRACKS, context)
68 |         axis = self.parameterAsSource(parameters, self.AXIS, context)
69 |         self.name_field = self.parameterAsString(parameters, self.NAME_FIELD, context)
70 |         self.axis = next(axis.getFeatures())
71 |         self.name_field_index = source.fields().indexFromName(self.name_field)
72 | 
73 |         (sink, dest_id) = self.parameterAsSink(
74 |             parameters,
75 |             self.OUTPUT,
76 |             context,
77 |             PreCourlisFileLine.base_fields(),
78 |             QgsWkbTypes.LineString,
79 |             source.sourceCrs(),
80 |         )
81 |         if sink is None:
82 |             raise QgsProcessingException(self.invalidSinkError(parameters, self.OUTPUT))
83 | 
84 |         total = 100.0 / source.featureCount() if source.featureCount() else 0
85 |         features = source.getFeatures()
86 | 
87 |         for current, feature in enumerate(features):
88 |             # Stop the algorithm if cancel button has been clicked
89 |             if feedback.isCanceled():
90 |                 break
91 | 
92 |             intersection = feature.geometry().intersection(self.axis.geometry())
93 |             assert not intersection.isNull()
94 | 
95 |             abs_long = self.axis.geometry().lineLocatePoint(intersection)
96 | 
97 |             # Take only the first parts (QgsMultiLineString => QgsLineString)
98 |             axis_line = next(self.axis.geometry().constParts()).clone()
99 |             track_line = next(feature.geometry().constParts()).clone()
100 | 
101 |             intersection_point = intersection.constGet()
102 |             track_angle = qgslinestring_angle(track_line, intersection_point) * (
103 |                 180 / math.pi
104 |             )
105 |             axis_angle = qgslinestring_angle(axis_line, intersection_point) * (
106 |                 180 / math.pi
107 |             )
108 |             d_angle = (track_angle - axis_angle) % 360
109 | 
110 |             out = QgsFeature()
111 |             out.setAttributes(
112 |                 [
113 |                     # sec_id
114 |                     None,
115 |                     # sec_name
116 |                     feature.attribute(self.name_field_index)
117 |                     if self.name_field
118 |                     else None,
119 |                     # abs_long
120 |                     abs_long,
121 |                     # axis_x
122 |                     intersection_point.x(),
123 |                     # axis_y
124 |                     intersection_point.y(),
125 |                     # layers
126 |                     "",
127 |                     # p_id
128 |                     QVariant(),
129 |                     # topo_bat
130 |                     "B",
131 |                     # abs_lat
132 |                     QVariant(),
133 |                     # zfond
134 |                     QVariant(),
135 |                 ]
136 |             )
137 |             if d_angle < 180:
138 |                 out.setGeometry(QgsGeometry(track_line.reversed()))
139 |             else:
140 |                 out.setGeometry(QgsGeometry(feature.geometry()))
141 | 
142 |             # Add a feature in the sink
143 |             sink.addFeature(out, QgsFeatureSink.FastInsert)
144 |

147 |

332 |         """
333 |         Create buffer around features.
334 | 
335 |         Args:
336 |             layer_name: Name of the input layer

340 |         Returns:

343 |         from qgis.core import (
344 |             QgsVectorLayer, QgsFeature, QgsGeometry,
345 |             QgsVectorFileWriter, QgsFields
346 |         )
347 | 
348 |         layer = self.get_layer(layer_name)
349 | 
350 |         # Create memory layer for buffers
351 |         crs = layer.crs().authid()
352 |         geom_type = "Polygon"
353 |         buffer_layer = QgsVectorLayer(f"{geom_type}?crs={crs}", "buffer", "memory")
354 |         buffer_provider = buffer_layer.dataProvider()
355 | 
356 |         # Copy fields
357 |         buffer_provider.addAttributes(layer.fields().toList())
358 |         buffer_layer.updateFields()
359 | 
360 |         # Create buffers
361 |         buffered_count = 0
362 |         for feature in layer.getFeatures():
363 |             geom = feature.geometry()
364 |             buffered_geom = geom.buffer(distance, 8)
365 | 
366 |             new_feature = QgsFeature()
367 |             new_feature.setGeometry(buffered_geom)
368 |             new_feature.setAttributes(feature.attributes())
369 |             buffer_provider.addFeatures([new_feature])
370 |             buffered_count += 1
371 | 
372 |         buffer_layer.updateExtents()
373 | 
374 |         # Save to file if path provided
375 |         if output_path:
376 |             output_path = Path(output_path)
377 |             output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

383 |             )
384 | 
385 |             return {
386 |                 "input_layer": layer_name,

388 |                 "features_buffered": buffered_count,

390 |             }
